purpose: Authoritative public-source registry for the 16 Quest Intelligence 360 laboratory and diagnostics competitor/comparator profiles monitored in Alerts & Signals.

refresh_policy.change_rule: A competitor last_updated_at changes only when normalized monitored information is added, removed or modified.
refresh_policy.content_policy: Prioritize clinical, product, regulatory, partnership, acquisition, technology, health-system, coverage, operational and strategic developments. Exclude stock-price moves, analyst ratings, dividends, share repurchases, investor-conference notices and earnings-only updates unless the item contains a distinct operational or strategic development.
refresh_policy.summary_policy: Every development surfaced in Alerts & Signals must have a completed concise article-level summary before it is displayed; pending-summary placeholders are not shown.
refresh_policy.automation_policy: No paid language-model API is required. Analyst review may be used as an optional review layer, while the scheduled job uses deterministic public-web extraction and runs without API keys.
